content.text:
At 5, the most effective first move is a "camping out" approach - start by sitting next to his bed until he falls asleep, then shift your chair a little further toward the door every couple of nights until you're out of the room entirely. A consistent wind-down routine (same order, same time) makes the transition stick faster.

Want the full night-by-night plan for moving Milo to his own bed? Reply YES and I'll send it.
